subject: Request: customer press kit / collateral usage in exchange for concession
messages:
From: Ava Reynolds <ava@nectaranalytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: collateral & logo use for pricing consideration

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the overview yesterday — Nectar is excited about Redwood for inference cost savings and the routing features. We're getting close on procurement but have one ask from our CMO before we sign: Nectar would like Redwood to grant permission to use our brand assets (logo, short quote, and one-page case blurb) in your marketing (website, sales collateral, and a joint blog/press mention). In exchange, the procurement team is requesting a 20% first-year discount and co-marketing support (one joint webinar slot).

We can provide a press kit and a short quote from our Head of ML. Can you let me know what Redwood needs (terms, approvals) to move this forward? Our signature timeline is end of month.

Attachments: nectar-usecases.pdf (pdf), brand-guidelines.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Ava Reynolds
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Nectar Analytics
ava@nectaranalytics.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: collateral & logo use for pricing consideration

Team — forwarding Ava's note from Nectar. They want logo + quote + blog/press mention in exchange for a 20% first-year discount and a webinar slot. Procurement wants this in the commercial, not a separate MSA.

Asking for quick guidance:
- Legal: Is this standard publicity permission language or do we need a separate publicity agreement?
- Marketing: Are we comfortable with a blog/press mention + logo use? Any exclusivity concerns?
- Sales: Can we accommodate 20% or do we propose a smaller marketing-for-credit swap?

Context: Deal ID DEAL-1984 in HubSpot. Customer hopes to sign by end of month (June 30). They attached a press kit (forwarded).

Forwarded attachments: nectar-usecases.pdf, customer-presskit.zip

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-16T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: collateral & logo use for pricing consideration

Hannah / team —

Quick legal read: brand/logo use and quotes are common, but we should not commit to any public press release or case study until: 1) we’ve verified the quote and technical accuracy, and 2) we have a signed Publicity & Use Agreement that covers IP, attribution, approval cycle, and termination.

I'm attaching a short publicity terms draft we can use as a baseline. We should avoid perpetual rights and ensure Redwood has the ability to approve final copy (standard 5 business-day review window). Also recommend we do not promise exclusivity or a timed joint press release unless we get additional consideration.

If Sales wants to trade a 20% concession for marketing, I need explicit approval from leadership for anything over 15% — plus sign-off that the customer will supply a marketing-ready asset and an approved quote.

Attachment: publicity-terms-draft.docx

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-17T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: collateral & logo use for pricing consideration

Thanks for the ping — marketing is supportive of a co-marketing arrangement but with caveats:
- We need a high-quality one-paragraph case blurb + a short quote (no more than 25 words) with explicit approval for the final copy.
- The joint blog / webinar should be scheduled within 60 days of signing; if they delay, marketing credit expires.
- No exclusivity. If they want a prominent homepage case study feature, we should negotiate additional PR budget or a higher concession.

If leadership approves a concession, marketing will provide a templated co-marketing plan and requirements for assets.

-Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: collateral & logo use for pricing consideration — leadership decision

Team — after reviewing the deal economics and the ask from Nectar, I'm authorizing a conditional concession:

- Approved concession: up to 15% off first-year list for DEAL-1984, plus co-marketing (one joint webinar and a blog post).
- Conditions: customer must sign the attached Publicity & Use Agreement (Markus' draft), provide marketing-ready assets (one-paragraph blurb and a 25-word quote), and agree to Redwood review/approval windows. No homepage hero placement without an additional monetary concession (separate approval required).
- Sales must log the concession in the HubSpot deal record and set an expiration (60 days) for the co-marketing commitment.

Hannah/Ben — execute the agreement with the customer and keep me in the loop if they push for more than 15% or insist on additional PR placement.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
